reference_evidence.limitations: No Archer build/run; no QCAE public consumer compilation or representative acceptance execution in this contract inventory slice.

authoritative_data: TaskService owns bounded async task state/events through an injected TaskPublisher. RecordApplication and artifact publishers remain the model/file authorities.

input_output: TaskRecord retains task id, frozen document/revision/profile, state/progress/events, optional diagnostic and exactly one model or artifact success receipt. TaskCancelResult carries task plus accepted bool.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: TaskPublisher callbacks serialize through one application and cannot re-enter TaskService. start/query/cancel/wait/reconcile return Result diagnostics. Precommit accepted cancellation publishes no model transaction; postcommit cancellation cannot roll back. Unknown commit waits for application recovery before reconcile; event sequence is retained.
implemented_subset.implemented_boundary: ConfigureRuntime is not a TaskService method. Configuration/logging/packaging and real solver process recovery remain separate platform adapters. Durable transition guarantees depend on installed load/persist/publish callbacks, not the scheduler constructor alone.

implemented_subset.failure_forms: start/query/wait return Result<TaskRecord>; cancel returns Result<TaskCancelResult> with accepted; reconcile returns Result<bool>. resource_limit, missing/invalid input, principal/session/revision/profile conflicts and persist/publication failures retain diagnostics. Terminal task.state and success receipt must be inspected separately from request admission.
